column1: # The platform's closed lists a manifest is held to, one table for the course and the product
# (each keeps its copy; the loader's lists of heartbeat strings and secret roles on both sides take it), byte for byte. Owner: «Спецификация»; the
# product's conformance — its own acceptance against this table (ADR-0080 доп. 16, ADR-0083). ADR-0019, its
# addition of 2026-10-10 (review 15 minor 15). A row is list, word; each list is a set — its order is not compared.
#   heartbeat_strings  the platform's own string fields of every heartbeat: a manifest's heartbeat.strings names none of them
#   secret_roles       the roles secrets.readers may name
#   secret_readers     the platform's own secret rows and who reads them, <row or prefix>=<role> (`<row>=` — nobody but
#                      a manifest that names a reader); ADR-0032, ADR-0066's addition of 2026-10-10. The domain's backups
#                      are objects, not secret rows (P/08.8 Н1.5; review 41): no row of them here
#   platform_shown     the platform's own unit fields a manifest may name where it shows a unit: display.tree.columns[].field
#   object_families    the platform's object families under objects/<sub>/: a manifest's objects.rows[] names none of them;
